data.name: Ashmoor
data.detailed_description:
Ashmoor is a PvE open world survival horror game where you explore a tainted land and solve the mystery to escape. Gather resources and craft defences to survive the night. Engage with NPCs to learn the way through the affliction. Fight. Adapt. Yield. Choose your own pathway, discover your own secrets, and survive.

Explore a procedurally generated open world map and learn the secrets it holds.   Interact with different NPCs to discover the hidden truth to what is afflicting the land before it drives you insane.   Each NPC gives their own perspective on what is happening based on their world view, choose which one to believe to escape.

The game features a day/night loop where you spend the day gathering resources, crafting defences, learning about the environment and fulfilling quests for NPCs.  At night, it's all about survival.  Survive the night to continue your quest, moving further and deeper into the woods.  

Fail, and you die.
